item.text:
Moved the species tuning constants into a centralized registry and rewired the species classes to read from it.

What changed:
- Added [SpeciesTuning.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R010_module_java/SpeciesTuning.java#L1) as the single source of truth for:
  - breeding age
  - max age
  - breeding probability
  - max litter size
  - newborn food level
  - active time window
  - prey food values
  - plant reproduction tuning
- Updated the species classes to use that registry instead of hardcoded class constants:
  - [Ant.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R010_module_java/Ant.java#L13)
  - [Dingo.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R010_module_java/Dingo.java#L13)
  - [Eagle.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R010_module_java/Eagle.java#L14)
  - [Emu.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R010_module_java/Emu.java#L13)
  - [Rat.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R010_module_java/Rat.java#L13)
  - [Snake.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R010_module_java/Snake.java#L13)
  - [Acacia.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R010_module_java/Acacia.java#L12)
  - [Grass.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R010_module_java/Grass.java#L12)
- The simulator still uses [SimulationConfig.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R010_module_java/SimulationConfig.java#L1) for global simulation settings and population rules, so the tuning is now split cleanly between global simulation config and per-species config.

Verification:
- `javac *.java` passed.

Tradeoff:
- This is registry-driven, but not dependency-injected into every entity instance. That keeps the change small and avoids threading config through every constructor, while still removing the hardcoded tuning values from the entity classes.

If you want, I can do a final cleanup pass to consolidate `SimulationConfig` and `SpeciesTuning` into one top-level configuration package so all tuning lives in one place.
